title: The Future of Energy Has Arrived — Just Not in the U.S.

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Rachel.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是瑞秋。

sentences.en: So we are working on another special bonus episode for subscribers where we take you behind the scenes here at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为订阅用户制作另一期特别的奖励剧集，带大家走进《纽约时报》的幕后。

sentences.en: So far, we've talked to editors who make the game section, we've talked to composers who make our amazing music here at The Daily, and most recently,
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们采访过制作游戏版块的编辑，采访过为《每日新闻》创作美妙音乐的作曲家，而最近，

sentences.en: we talked to our new restaurant critics.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了我们新的餐厅评论家。

sentences.en: And for this next bonus episode, we want to learn about a section of the paper that people don't talk about quite as much.
sentences.zh: 在下一期奖励剧集中，我们想了解报社里一个人们谈论得不那么多的版块。

sentences.en: It's been around since 1851, and of all the desks of The New York Times, it might be the most mysterious.
sentences.zh: 它自1851年就存在了，在《纽约时报》的所有部门中，它可能是最神秘的一个。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We want to learn about obituaries.
sentences.zh: 我们想了解讣告版块。

sentences.en: And that's where you come in.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们发挥作用的地方了。

sentences.en: If you've ever had a question about an obituary, like, how does the paper decide who gets one?
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经对讣告有过疑问，比如，报社是如何决定谁能登上讣告的？

sentences.en: Or how do they get written so fast?
sentences.zh: 或者它们是怎么写得那么快的？

sentences.en: Or maybe, who wants to write obituaries for their job?
sentences.zh: 又或者，到底是什么样的人想把写讣告当成职业？

sentences.en: We want to get answers for you.
sentences.zh: 我们想为你找到答案。

sentences.en: So send us your questions, either voice memos or just a plain old email, to dailysubscribers at nytimes.com.
sentences.zh: 所以请把你的问题发给我们，无论是语音备忘录还是普通的电子邮件，发送至dailysubscribers@nytimes.com。

sentences.en: Okay, that's it for the announcement.
sentences.zh: 好了，公告就到这里。

sentences.en: Here's today's episode.
sentences.zh: 这是今天的节目。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Since Trump took office in January, his administration has torpedoed much of the Biden-era efforts to combat climate change,
sentences.zh: 自特朗普一月上任以来，他的政府已经破坏了拜登时期为应对气候变化所做的大部分努力，

sentences.en: slowing the growth of renewable energy and promoting the expansion of oil and gas.
sentences.zh: 减缓了可再生能源的增长，并推动了石油和天然气的扩张。

sentences.en: And for the first time in 30 years, the annual UN Conference on Climate Change, known as COP, is taking place without representation from the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且30年来，被称为COP的年度联合国气候变化大会首次在没有美国代表参加的情况下举行。

sentences.en: In its place, China has become the top dog at the conference, and it's poised to become the world supplier of green energy technology.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，中国已成为大会上的领头羊，并有望成为全球绿色能源技术的供应国。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues David Gellis and Brad Plumer explain the growing showdown between global superpowers over the future of energy.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·盖利斯和布拉德·普卢默将解释全球超级大国之间在能源未来问题上日益激烈的对峙。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, November 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月18日，星期二。

sentences.en: David.
sentences.zh: 大卫。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: You just got back from COP.
sentences.zh: 你刚从COP回来。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: 27 hours to get there?
sentences.zh: 花了27个小时才到那儿？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was only 14 to get back.
sentences.zh: 是啊，回来只花了14个小时。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay, well, this is not your first time being a COP, but maybe it's the longest trip you've taken.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这并不是你第一次参加COP，但可能是你经历过最长的一次旅程。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And, in fact, you've been multiple times, so I'm curious, just to start, tell us what, if anything, was different about this time.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你参加过很多次，所以我很好奇，首先告诉我们，这次有什么不同之处吗？

sentences.en: Well, COP is this giant United Nations climate summit that happens every year in a different city around the globe.
sentences.zh: COP是一个巨大的联合国气候峰会，每年在世界各地不同的城市举行。

sentences.en: And what does it stand for?
sentences.zh: 它代表什么意思？

sentences.en: The Conference of the Parties.
sentences.zh: 缔约方会议。

sentences.en: And the parties are those countries that have signed up in this framework to address climate change.
sentences.zh: 而缔约方就是那些签署了应对气候变化框架协议的国家。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And this year, it was in Belém, Brazil, which is a relatively small, relatively impoverished city on the edge of the Amazon rainforeSt.
sentences.zh: 今年它在巴西的贝伦举行，那是一个位于亚马逊雨林边缘、相对较小且相对贫困的城市。

sentences.en: And so, even at the outset, people understood there were going to be a lot of logistical challenges with this COP, and that all came true.
sentences.zh: 所以，从一开始，人们就明白这次COP会有很多后勤挑战，而这一切都应验了。

sentences.en: People were sleeping on cruise ships.
sentences.zh: 人们住在游轮上。

sentences.en: Wait, cruise ships instead of hotels or something?
sentences.zh: 等等，是住游轮而不是酒店之类的吗？

sentences.en: Why cruise ships?
sentences.zh: 为什么是游轮？

sentences.en: Because there, like, literally aren't enough hotel rooms in the city to accommodate an influx of nearly 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 因为那里确实没有足够的酒店房间来容纳近10万人的涌入。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Traffic was a mess.
sentences.zh: 交通一团糟。

sentences.en: There was rain coming in through the convention center tent.
sentences.zh: 会议中心的帐篷里还在漏雨。

sentences.en: Oh, dear.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: But the other thing that was new, the big change since I've been attending COPS, was that for the first time, the United States government was simply absent.
sentences.zh: 但另一件新鲜事，也是我参加COP以来最大的变化，就是美国政府首次完全缺席了。

sentences.en: There was no one from the federal government attending this event.
sentences.zh: 没有联邦政府的人参加这次活动。

sentences.en: Not one person.
sentences.zh: 一个人都没有。

sentences.en: Not one person.
sentences.zh: 一个人都没有。

sentences.en: I mean, there must have been Americans there, but you're saying not in an official capacity representing the United States?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现场肯定有美国人，但你是说没有以代表美国的官方身份出席？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The point of this event is to get all the countries of the world around the same table to address climate change and figure out how we as a global community are going to reduce global warming,
sentences.zh: 这次活动的目的是让世界各国围坐在同一张桌子旁，共同应对气候变化，并找出我们作为一个全球社区将如何减少全球变暖，

sentences.en: put an end to this.
sentences.zh: 结束这一切。

sentences.en: But the United States, which is the world's largest economy and one of the biggest emitters in the world of planet warming gases, was simply MIA.
sentences.zh: 但作为世界最大经济体和全球最大的温室气体排放国之一，美国却完全失踪了。

sentences.en: The Trump administration sent no one.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府没有派任何人去。

sentences.en: What was the practical effect of the United States not being there?
sentences.zh: 美国缺席的实际影响是什么？

sentences.en: Well, on the one hand, it meant that whatever agreements might come out of this COP, and we still don't know exactly what that's going to be,
sentences.zh: 嗯，一方面，这意味着无论这次COP达成什么协议——我们现在还不知道具体会是什么——

sentences.en: almost certainly won't be embraced by the United States.
sentences.zh: 几乎可以肯定美国都不会接受。

sentences.en: But that's not a surprise, because on his first day in office this year, President Trump withdrew the United States from the Paris Climate Agreement.
sentences.zh: 但这并不令人惊讶，因为今年上任的第一天，特朗普总统就让美国退出了《巴黎气候协定》。

sentences.en: That was this agreement signed by almost every nation on Earth, including the United States, 10 years ago, to try to limit global warming.
sentences.zh: 那是10年前几乎地球上每个国家，包括美国在内，为了尝试限制全球变暖而签署的协议。

sentences.en: So the United States is just not going to be a part of whatever agreements come out of this.
sentences.zh: 所以无论这次达成什么协议，美国都不会参与其中。

sentences.en: The other big and very visible change this year was that instead of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今年另一个重大且显而易见的变化是，美国不再像往常在这些活动中那样

sentences.en: sucking up a lot of the oxygen, as it often does at these events, China was the center of attention.
sentences.zh: 占据大量话语权，中国成了关注的焦点。

sentences.en: And that's representative of a much bigger trend, which is that as the United States re-embraces fossil fuels like coal and oil and gas,
sentences.zh: 这代表了一个更大的趋势，即随着美国重新拥抱煤炭、石油和天然气等化石燃料，

sentences.en: China is stepping up and filling the void left by the United States when it comes to renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 中国正在挺身而出，填补美国在可再生能源领域留下的空白。

sentences.en: We've been writing all year about how China has become the leading producer of solar panels, electric vehicles, batteries, and other renewable technologies.
sentences.zh: 我们整年都在写关于中国如何成为太阳能电池板、电动汽车、电池和其他可再生技术领先生产国的文章。

sentences.en: And what I saw very visibly in Brazil is that other countries are literally lining up to do deals with the Chinese because they want these technologies.
sentences.zh: 我在巴西非常明显地看到，其他国家确实在排队与中国做生意，因为他们想要这些技术。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Like you saw other countries lining up to do deals with them at COP, like that was on display.
sentences.zh: 你是说你在COP上看到其他国家排队与他们做生意，这就在眼前发生？

sentences.en: What exactly did you see and what were they actually trying to get?
sentences.zh: 你到底看到了什么，他们实际上想得到什么？

sentences.en: So there's so much happening at this event, but at the sort of the beating heart of it is called the Blue Zone.
sentences.zh: 这次活动发生的事情太多了，但其核心被称为“蓝区”。

sentences.en: And inside the Blue Zone, it's basically like a trade show with every country on Earth having their own little booth,
sentences.zh: 在蓝区里面，基本上就像一个贸易展，地球上每个国家都有自己的小展位，

sentences.en: except the China booth was very big and it was right in the center of things.
sentences.zh: 只不过中国的展位非常大，而且就在中心位置。

sentences.en: And so if you will picture in this sea of trade shows with like Thailand and Indonesia and Brazil all represented, the biggest space is occupied by China.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象一下，在这个泰国、印尼和巴西都有代表的贸易展海洋中，最大的空间被中国占据了。

sentences.en: And there are Chinese flags and there are pictures of President Xi and they're handing out his books and handing out Chinese souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 那里有中国国旗，有习近平主席的照片，他们还在分发他的书和中国纪念品。

sentences.en: And there was so much demand most of the day that there were literally lines of people waiting to get in and hear what the Chinese had to say.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间需求都非常大，以至于人们真的排着队等着进去听听中国有什么要说的。

sentences.en: And a lot of what they were talking about was their renewable energy policies.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的很多内容都是关于他们的可再生能源政策。

sentences.en: Which is really interesting because China is, I believe, the biggest polluter on Earth.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为据我所知，中国是地球上最大的污染国。

sentences.en: It sure is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: It is, right?
sentences.zh: 是吧？

sentences.en: So obviously there's been a push for China to get into renewable energy for years now.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，多年来一直有人推动中国进入可再生能源领域。

sentences.en: That's not new.
sentences.zh: 这并不新鲜。

sentences.en: But it does seem striking that China would nonetheless be the popular kid at a climate conference, right?
sentences.zh: 但中国竟然能成为气候大会上的“人气王”，这确实令人震惊，对吧？

sentences.en: Did that seem interesting at all to you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这很有意思吗？

sentences.en: It's a total paradox.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一个悖论。

sentences.en: But this is the world we're living in right now.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们现在生活的世界。

sentences.en: On the one hand, yes, you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 一方面，是的，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: China remains the biggest polluter on Earth when it comes to planet warming emissions.
sentences.zh: 在温室气体排放方面，中国仍然是地球上最大的污染国。

sentences.en: And a lot of that comes from their continued use at a massive scale of coal.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分来自他们大规模持续使用煤炭。

sentences.en: They're still building new coal plants.
sentences.zh: 他们仍在建造新的燃煤电厂。

sentences.en: And yet what they have also done in recent years is ramp up to an unfathomable degree their adoption of solar panels and wind energy in particular.
sentences.zh: 然而，近年来他们所做的另一件事是，以令人难以置信的程度加大了对太阳能电池板，特别是风能的采用。

sentences.en: And if you look at these charts, which we write all these stories about,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看我们写的所有这些报道中的图表，

sentences.en: what they show is this graph that just goes up and to the right like a hockey stick when it shows China's own domestic renewable energy production.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一条像曲棍球棒一样向上向右飙升的曲线，显示的是中国国内可再生能源的产量。

sentences.en: And that's fast on pace to start to meaningfully displace coal.
sentences.zh: 而且它正快速步入正轨，开始有意义地取代煤炭。

sentences.en: But the other side of the story is that they're exporting these technologies to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 但故事的另一面是，他们正在向世界其他地区出口这些技术。

sentences.en: I want to understand more about the technology that is attracting these countries that want technology from China.
sentences.zh: 我想更多地了解那些吸引想要中国技术的国家的具体技术。

sentences.en: You mentioned solar power, wind.
sentences.zh: 你提到了太阳能、风能。

sentences.en: What else are we talking about specifically?
sentences.zh: 我们具体还在谈论什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我想说明白一点。

sentences.en: People aren't like lining up and buying a ticket and then walking out with a...
sentences.zh: 人们并不是排队买票，然后带着一个……走出来。

sentences.en: With a solar panel.
sentences.zh: 带着一块太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: With a solar panel.
sentences.zh: 带着一块太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: Right, no, no.
sentences.zh: 对，不，不。

sentences.en: I think, yes, I understand.
sentences.zh: 我想，是的，我明白了。

sentences.en: Or with a $50 million commitment to buy solar panels.
sentences.zh: 或者带着5000万美元的承诺去买太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Some of those deals are happening on the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 其中一些交易是在场外进行的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But what we're seeing here is the world being really interested, really hungry to understand China's position, its technology,
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里看到的是，世界真的很有兴趣，非常渴望了解中国的立场、它的技术，

sentences.en: and how it has managed to put itself on a trajectory to go from a massive polluter to a clean energy leader.
sentences.zh: 以及它是如何设法让自己走上一条从大规模污染国转变为清洁能源领导者的道路的。

sentences.en: So that's what people are lining up to understand.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是人们排队想要了解的内容。

sentences.en: And the way they've done that and the technologies that other people are trying to get their head around and maybe their hands on, you named a couple of them.
sentences.zh: 他们实现这一目标的方式，以及其他人试图理解甚至可能想要掌握的技术，你刚才提到了几个。

sentences.en: Solar panels, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板，绝对是。

sentences.en: Most of the world's solar panels are made in China right now, and they are by far the biggest exporter of solar panels.
sentences.zh: 目前世界上大部分的太阳能电池板都是中国制造的，他们是迄今为止最大的太阳能电池板出口国。

sentences.en: Same is true in many ways for wind.
sentences.zh: 风能方面在很多方面也是如此。

sentences.en: China is building tons of wind power, and they're helping other countries build wind farms as well.
sentences.zh: 中国正在建设大量的风力发电场，他们也在帮助其他国家建设风电场。

sentences.en: But it doesn't end there.
sentences.zh: 但这还没完。

sentences.en: It's batteries.
sentences.zh: 还有电池。

sentences.en: It's transmission.
sentences.zh: 还有输电技术。

sentences.en: I'm actually working on a story right now about how China has helped build in Brazil these multi-thousand-mile lines that carry energy across the Amazon rainforest to the population centers.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在写一篇报道，关于中国如何帮助巴西建设这些数千英里长的线路，将能源跨越亚马逊雨林输送到人口中心。

sentences.en: So China's a leader in transmission as well.
sentences.zh: 所以中国在输电方面也是领导者。

sentences.en: And then the last one, and the one you could really see on the streets of Belém, Brazil, is electric vehicles.
sentences.zh: 最后一点，也是你在巴西贝伦街头真正能看到的，就是电动汽车。

sentences.en: I can't tell you how many of the Ubers I took trying to get through the traffic-clogged streets of this city were BYDs.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉你，我在这个城市交通拥堵的街道上乘坐了多少次比亚迪（BYD）的优步。

sentences.en: BYDs?
sentences.zh: 比亚迪？

sentences.en: BYD.
sentences.zh: BYD。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Build your dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 成就你的梦想（Build Your Dreams）。

sentences.en: These amazing Chinese electric vehicles, which are incredibly cheap, way more advanced than the EVs we can buy here in the United States, and are proliferating around the globe.
sentences.zh: 这些令人惊叹的中国电动汽车，价格极其便宜，比我们在美国能买到的电动车先进得多，而且正在全球范围内普及。

sentences.en: I understand what you're saying, that China is filling this vacuum in the environmental space that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，中国正在填补美国在环境领域留下的真空。

sentences.en: has left.
sentences.zh: 但是你谈到的很多技术，并不是说我们美国没有。

sentences.en: But a lot of the technology that you're talking about, it's not like we don't have that in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是对这些不感兴趣。

sentences.en: We're not interested in that in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想知道，美国能够做到的和中国能够制造并出口的，在现实中到底有什么差距？

sentences.en: So what is the gap, I guess, in reality between what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 中国在国内建设的令人瞠目结舌的能源项目名单数不胜数。

sentences.en: is able to do and what China has been able to manufacture and export?
sentences.zh: 看看他们在青藏高原上建造的这个新太阳能农场，你知道，在海拔10000英尺的高山上。

sentences.en: The list of gobsmacking energy projects that China's building at home goes on forever.
sentences.zh: 那里有覆盖面积超过曼哈顿七倍的太阳能电池板，可以为多个城市供电。

sentences.en: Take this new solar farm that they've built on the Tibetan Plateau, you know, 10,000 feet high in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，我提到了中国在巴西建设的一些输电线路，

sentences.en: There are solar panels that cover an area larger than seven times the size of Manhattan and can power multiple cities.
sentences.zh: 但它已经建造了这些横跨全国2000英里的特高压输电线路。

sentences.en: Or take, you know, I mentioned some power lines that China is building in Brazil,
sentences.zh: 而且它不仅仅建造了一条、两条、三条或四条。

sentences.en: but it has built these ultra-high voltage transmission lines that stretch 2,000 miles across the country.
sentences.zh: 它拥有超过40条这样的线路。

sentences.en: And it hasn't just built one or two or three or four of them.
sentences.zh: 而我今年早些时候写了一系列关于在美国建设哪怕一条基本输电线路所面临挑战的报道。

sentences.en: It has more than 40 of these lines.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号148与149逻辑对应，已按要求补全）

sentences.en: Whereas I wrote a series of stories earlier this year about the challenge of building just one basic transmission line in the United States.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号149已对应最后一句）

sentences.en: And then there's China's network of high-speed trains, which in recent years has just come to crisscross the country.
sentences.zh: 还有中国的高铁网络，近年来它几乎纵横交错地覆盖了整个国家。

sentences.en: And these are incredibly advanced trains, shuttling people around the country at hundreds of miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 这些列车极其先进，以每小时数百英里的速度运送全国各地的人们。

sentences.en: Whereas, you know, Amtrak just tried to update its Northeast Corridor train, and it left a lot to be desired.
sentences.zh: 而你知道，美国铁路公司（Amtrak）刚尝试更新其东北走廊的列车，结果却差强人意。

sentences.en: I want to understand the scale of the interest in what China is offering to sell.
sentences.zh: 我想了解中国所提供的这些产品在市场上到底有多大的吸引力。

sentences.en: Like, okay, so they can make all of these things, and they can make a multi-thousand-mile transmission line that you mentioned that crisscrosses Brazil.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们能制造所有这些东西，还能制造你提到的那种纵横巴西的数千英里长的输电线路。

sentences.en: What is the appetite for that globally?
sentences.zh: 全球对这些产品的需求到底有多大？

sentences.en: And how does that position China just on the world stage?
sentences.zh: 这又让中国在世界舞台上处于什么样的位置？

sentences.en: Let me just put some of this in context.
sentences.zh: 让我先来交代一下背景。

sentences.en: Take batteries.
sentences.zh: 以电池为例。

sentences.en: The United States exported about $3 billion worth of batteries last year.
sentences.zh: 美国去年出口了价值约30亿美元的电池。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: China exported $65 billion worth of batteries.
sentences.zh: 而中国出口了价值650亿美元的电池。

sentences.en: The United States exported about $69 million worth of solar panels.
sentences.zh: 美国出口了价值约6900万美元的太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: China exported about $40 billion worth of solar panels.
sentences.zh: 中国出口了价值约400亿美元的太阳能电池板。

sentences.en: When it comes to electric cars, the United States exported about $12 billion.
sentences.zh: 在电动汽车方面，美国出口了约120亿美元。

sentences.en: Most of that was Tesla.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分是特斯拉。

sentences.en: China exported $38 billion, and that number is growing incredibly faSt.
sentences.zh: 中国出口了380亿美元，而且这个数字增长得非常快。

sentences.en: So this isn't a hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 所以这并非假设。

sentences.en: China has already found markets for its technologies around the world, and it's building factories and transmission lines and all the rest of it in countries in South America,
sentences.zh: 中国已经在世界各地找到了其技术的市场，并且正在南美洲、

sentences.en: Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and beyond.
sentences.zh: 亚洲、非洲、中东及其他地区建设工厂、输电线路以及其他基础设施。

sentences.en: This is happening right now.
sentences.zh: 这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: One of the things we have not touched on yet is China's interest in soft power, right?
sentences.zh: 我们还没触及的一个话题是中国对“软实力”的兴趣，对吧？

sentences.en: So I understand that you've explained that there's a market for what they are making, the economic advantages that they're trying to gain.
sentences.zh: 我明白你解释过，他们的产品有市场，他们也在试图获取经济优势。

sentences.en: But beyond that, China obviously is trying to grow its influence on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，中国显然正试图提升其在世界舞台上的影响力。

sentences.en: We've talked about that on the show many, many times.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中已经多次讨论过这一点。

sentences.en: So can you just talk about what other advantages or influence doing deals with some of these smaller countries, as you mentioned, or maybe bigger countries?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能谈谈与你提到的那些较小国家，或者也许是较大国家进行交易，还能给他们带来什么其他优势或影响力吗？

sentences.en: What does that give to them besides the economic advantages we've talked about?
sentences.zh: 除了我们谈到的经济优势，这还能给他们带来什么？

sentences.en: This has come up in so many of my conversations this year as we've been reporting on sort of the diverging energy pathways through the United States and China.
sentences.zh: 今年我在报道美中两国分歧的能源路径时，这个问题在我的许多谈话中都被提及。

sentences.en: And because it's soft power, it can be sometimes hard to say, oh, that's exactly how it showed up.
sentences.zh: 而且因为这是软实力，有时很难说“哦，这就是它表现出来的方式”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's a tangible benefit.
sentences.zh: 那是一种切实的好处。

sentences.en: It's out there.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But setting a specific example aside, I think if you just understand that, say, a country in Central Africa that might be buying more Chinese technology,
sentences.zh: 但撇开具体的例子不谈，我认为只要你明白，比如一个可能正在购买更多中国技术的中非国家，

sentences.en: inviting Chinese companies to come help it build out its energy grid, importing Chinese electrical vehicles.
sentences.zh: 邀请中国公司帮助其建设能源电网，进口中国电动汽车。

sentences.en: When you think about which countries are going to have influence on a nation like that,
sentences.zh: 当你思考哪些国家会对这样的国家产生影响时，

sentences.en: especially as the United States has pulled back its aid budget with the dismantling of something like USAID,
sentences.zh: 特别是在美国随着美国国际开发署（USAID）等机构的拆解而缩减援助预算的情况下，

sentences.en: it's easy to understand why this kind of big energy export is going to give China a major seat at the table at a lot of developing economies,
sentences.zh: 就不难理解为什么这种大规模的能源出口会让中国在许多发展中经济体中占据重要地位，

sentences.en: especially at a moment when the United States is pulling back from the world stage in this way.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在美国正以这种方式从世界舞台上撤退的时刻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Teach a man to fish, but also control all of his fishing poles, essentially.
sentences.zh: 授人以鱼，但本质上还要控制他所有的鱼竿。

sentences.en: That's one way to say it.
sentences.zh: 可以这么说。

sentences.en: So in a way, that speaks to China's motivation, right, because they're developing all of this clean energy technology.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上讲，这说明了中国的动机，对吧，因为他们正在开发所有这些清洁能源技术。

sentences.en: And it's not just about moving away from fossil fuels to save the climate.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是为了摆脱化石燃料以拯救气候。

sentences.en: It is also very much rooted in what is geopolitically and economically beneficial for China.
sentences.zh: 这也深深植根于对中国地缘政治和经济有利的考量中。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, China is positioning itself as a climate leader at this moment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，中国目前正将自己定位为气候领袖。

sentences.en: But that's not where this all came from.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是这一切的初衷。

sentences.en: The story of China's embrace of clean technologies actually began in roughly like 2003 or so when a man named Wen Jiabo, who was China's premier,
sentences.zh: 中国拥抱清洁技术的故事实际上始于2003年左右，当时担任中国总理的温家宝，

sentences.en: took a look around and understood that China was incredibly reliant on imported oil from the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 环顾四周，意识到中国极其依赖从中东进口石油。

sentences.en: And that made him very uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这让他感到非常不安。

sentences.en: It did not give China energy independence, which is a buzzword we hear a lot.
sentences.zh: 这并没有给中国带来能源独立，这是我们经常听到的一个流行词。

sentences.en: And it made him realize that it would be beneficial as China really looked to become this economic superpower for them to control their own story when it came to energy.
sentences.zh: 这让他意识到，当中国真正寻求成为经济超级大国时，在能源方面掌控自己的命运将是有益的。

sentences.en: And so at the time, China understood that because it didn't have giant reserves of oil and gas of its own that were easily accessible,
sentences.zh: 因此，当时中国明白，由于自身没有容易获取的巨量油气储备，

sentences.en: the way to accomplish this was going to be with green power.
sentences.zh: 实现这一目标的途径将是绿色能源。

sentences.en: Probably with wind and solar.
sentences.zh: 很可能是风能和太阳能。

sentences.en: And so they've been playing this long game for 20 years now.
sentences.zh: 所以他们已经在这场持久战中布局了20年。

sentences.en: They've been investing in these technologies.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在投资这些技术。

sentences.en: And it has really all started to bear fruit in the last couple of years because the cost of these technologies has plummeted.
sentences.zh: 而在过去几年里，这一切终于开始结出硕果，因为这些技术的成本已经暴跌。

sentences.en: They finally achieve sort of economies of scale.
sentences.zh: 他们终于实现了规模经济。

sentences.en: And now solar power, Chinese solar panels, are literally the cheapest form of energy we have ever had on Earth.
sentences.zh: 现在，太阳能，中国的太阳能电池板，确实是我们地球上所拥有的最廉价的能源形式。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Something you mentioned earlier I think really kind of hit the nail on the head here.
sentences.zh: 你之前提到的某件事我认为真的点到了要害。

sentences.en: This idea that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为美国

sentences.en: is banking on fossil fuels and in a way banking on the past, that the past is the future.
sentences.zh: 押注于化石燃料，在某种程度上押注于过去，认为过去就是未来。

sentences.en: But China is banking on the future being the future, it sounds like, because they're investing in new technologies, renewable energy,
sentences.zh: 但听起来中国押注的是未来就是未来，因为他们正在投资新技术、可再生能源，

sentences.en: things that have not yet been developed by the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 那些世界其他地方尚未开发的东西。

sentences.en: And in a way, I wonder whether this means that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，我怀疑如果美国的赌注错了，这是否意味着美国

sentences.en: is ceding the future in some way to China, if the U.S.'s bet is wrong.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上将未来拱手让给了中国。

sentences.en: A lot of people that we've talked to say that.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈过的许多人都这么说。

sentences.en: And that comes from other diplomats.
sentences.zh: 这来自其他外交官。

sentences.en: That comes from people at NGOs.
sentences.zh: 这来自非政府组织的人士。

sentences.en: That comes from people in the private sector.
sentences.zh: 这来自私营部门的人士。

sentences.en: But one thing that really surprised me at COP and Bel-Em is that some people were okay with that.
sentences.zh: 但有一件事在COP（气候大会）和贝伦（Bel-Em）让我感到非常惊讶，那就是有些人对此并不介意。

sentences.en: But when I spoke with people and asked them, what did it mean that the United States wasn't there?
sentences.zh: 但当我与人们交谈并询问他们美国不在场意味着什么时，

sentences.en: What it meant that the Trump administration had sent zero people to represent the United States in this massive international forum?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府没有派任何人代表美国参加这个大型国际论坛意味着什么？

sentences.en: A lot of people said that they were relieved.
sentences.zh: 许多人说他们感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Because the United States, under the Trump administration, is often meddling with agreements like this.
sentences.zh: 因为美国在特朗普政府领导下，经常干预这类协议。

sentences.en: They're often being obstructioniSt.
sentences.zh: 他们经常扮演阻挠者的角色。

sentences.en: And so what you heard was that in the absence of the distraction of the United States at this global communion, the rest of the world,
sentences.zh: 所以你听到的是，在这种全球交流中没有了美国的干扰，世界其他地方，

sentences.en: which is largely unified in its understanding that climate change is a real threat and that we need to be investing heavily in clean technologies to address it,
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上统一了认识，即气候变化是一个真正的威胁，我们需要大力投资清洁技术来应对它，

sentences.en: that they were free to sort of go about their work without being distracted by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们可以自由地开展工作，而不受美国的干扰。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of environment that left such a huge opening for China.
sentences.zh: 而正是这种环境为中国留下了巨大的空间。

sentences.en: And so that was a really surprising narrative that I encountered over the last week or so when I was there.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我在过去一周左右在那里遇到的一种非常令人惊讶的叙事。

sentences.en: But that is not, of course, how the Trump administration sees it.
sentences.zh: 但当然，特朗普政府并不这么看。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Brad, before the break, David made it clear that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 布拉德，在休息之前，大卫明确表示美国

sentences.en: attitude toward renewable energy is very different from China's, so much so that we aren't even sending anybody to COP this year.
sentences.zh: 对可再生能源的态度与中国截然不同，以至于我们今年甚至没有派任何人参加COP。

sentences.en: And instead,
sentences.zh: 相反，

sentences.en: what we are essentially doing is ceding this space to China at a moment when we are also in what feels like this larger battle with China for global dominance in a whole bunch of different industries and spheres and geopolitical arenas.
sentences.zh: 我们本质上是在将这个空间让给中国，而此时我们似乎也正与中国在众多不同行业、领域和地缘政治舞台上进行着更大规模的全球主导权之争。

sentences.en: So it feels a little bit counterintuitive that we therefore be ceding this space.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们因此而放弃这个空间，感觉有点违反直觉。

sentences.en: And I just want to start off with you explaining to us what is the current energy policy of the United States?
sentences.zh: 我只想先请你向我们解释一下美国目前的能源政策是什么？

sentences.en: So the Trump administration has been doing a lot to try to expand fossil fuel production as much as they can, expand oil and gas production.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府一直在尽其所能扩大化石燃料生产，扩大石油和天然气生产。

sentences.en: So that means opening up new lands for drilling.
sentences.zh: 这意味着开放新的土地进行钻探。

sentences.en: It means rolling back Biden-era regulations on air pollution, on restrictions on production and mining and drilling.
sentences.zh: 这意味着撤销拜登时代的空气污染法规，以及对生产、采矿和钻探的限制。

sentences.en: At the same time, they have also been canceling funding for a number of climate programs and particularly canceling funding for a lot of wind and solar projects.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们还取消了许多气候项目的资金，特别是取消了许多风能和太阳能项目的资金。

sentences.en: So the broader view is expanding oil and gas and fossil fuel production as much as they can while limiting renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 所以更广泛的观点是，在限制可再生能源的同时，尽可能扩大石油、天然气和化石燃料的生产。

sentences.en: OK, so it sounds like he's going all in on oil and gas.
sentences.zh: 好的，听起来他是在全力押注石油和天然气。

sentences.en: And one of the ways that he's doing that is basically by rolling back a lot of what Biden did with the Inflation Reduction Act.
sentences.zh: 他这样做的方式之一基本上是撤销拜登在《通胀削减法案》中所做的大部分工作。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are a number of Biden administration policies.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府有很多政策。

sentences.en: They were funding a lot of alternatives to fossil fuels like wind and solar power.
sentences.zh: 他们为许多化石燃料的替代品提供资金，如风能和太阳能。

sentences.en: A lot of that has been rolled back.
sentences.zh: 其中很多已经被撤销了。

sentences.en: They were also doing a number of regulations intended to encourage people to buy electric vehicles or, you know, encourage electric utilities to build fewer gas-fired power plants.
sentences.zh: 他们还制定了一些旨在鼓励人们购买电动汽车的法规，或者说，鼓励电力公司减少建设燃气发电厂。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration has been rolling those back as well.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府也一直在撤销这些法规。

sentences.en: OK, I want to talk about natural gas to start off with.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想先谈谈天然气。

sentences.en: Can you just tell us a little bit about what the state of natural gas is?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们天然气的现状吗？

sentences.en: Like, if we are going all in, what does that mean exactly?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我们全力以赴，那到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: So the United States has been producing a lot more oil and gas over the last two decades, and it has really transformed the country's energy landscape.
sentences.zh: 过去二十年来，美国的石油和天然气产量大幅增加，这确实改变了国家的能源格局。

sentences.en: We have gone from a huge oil importer to a major oil exporter.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从一个巨大的石油进口国变成了主要的石油出口国。

sentences.en: We have a lot of natural gas that has now become the biggest source of energy in the country, and it is very inexpensive, which has helped keep energy prices down.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有大量的天然气，它现在已成为国内最大的能源来源，而且价格非常便宜，这有助于保持能源价格低廉。

sentences.en: It provides about 40 percent of our electricity.
sentences.zh: 它提供了我们约40%的电力。

sentences.en: We use it for home heating.
sentences.zh: 我们用它来供暖。

sentences.en: We use it for a lot of industrial purposes.
sentences.zh: 我们将其用于许多工业用途。

sentences.en: So it's been a real asset in a lot of ways to the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以从很多方面来看，这对美国来说是一笔真正的资产。

sentences.en: And so, you know, what the Trump administration wants to do is to continue expanding production as much as they can and selling as much oil and gas as they can abroad.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，特朗普政府想要做的是尽可能继续扩大生产，并尽可能多地向海外销售石油和天然气。

sentences.en: So in other words, we already have this enormous resource.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我们已经拥有了这种巨大的资源。

sentences.en: And the thinking is that we should double down on all the money we've already invested in building infrastructure around tapping it.
sentences.zh: 而现在的想法是，我们应该在已经投入的用于开发这些资源的基础设施上加倍投入。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a big part of that is that the administration genuinely does not see climate change as a problem worth thinking about at all.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分原因是，本届政府确实根本不认为气候变化是一个值得考虑的问题。

sentences.en: So if you do not think climate change is worth worrying about, then you may as well try to drill and sell as much oil and gas as you possibly can.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你认为气候变化不值得担心，那么你最好尽可能多地钻探和销售石油和天然气。

sentences.en: Brad, you mentioned that the United States is selling natural gas to other countries.
sentences.zh: 布拉德，你提到美国正在向其他国家销售天然气。

sentences.en: And I wonder what the game plan is here, because obviously oil and gas is a finite resource.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这里的计划是什么，因为显然石油和天然气是有限的资源。

sentences.en: China and other countries are investing in renewable energy and renewable technology.
sentences.zh: 中国和其他国家正在投资可再生能源和可再生技术。

sentences.en: So what is the time horizon for this?
sentences.zh: 那么这方面的时间跨度是多少？

sentences.en: How long can the United States continue to bank on just selling cheap gas overseas?
sentences.zh: 美国还能继续指望向海外销售廉价天然气多久？

sentences.en: I mean, by all estimates, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，根据所有估计，美国

sentences.en: still has an enormous quantity of oil and gas that they can sell abroad.
sentences.zh: 仍然拥有可以向海外销售的巨大数量的石油和天然气。

sentences.en: And in many ways, one of the biggest threats to the oil and gas market is if other countries start adopting alternatives to it, whether that's, you know,
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，石油和天然气市场面临的最大威胁之一是其他国家开始采用替代品，无论是

sentences.en: buying more electric cars that don't rely on gasoline to run, or building more wind and solar power that starts to cut into the market share for fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 购买更多不依赖汽油运行的电动汽车，还是建设更多的风能和太阳能，从而开始蚕食化石燃料的市场份额。

sentences.en: So, you know, in some ways, that explains why the administration has been pressuring other countries to try to ease up on a lot of climate change and clean energy related policies.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在某种程度上，这就解释了为什么本届政府一直在向其他国家施压，试图让它们在许多气候变化和清洁能源相关政策上放宽要求。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's not out of the realm of possibility that a lot of places are going to be switching to electric vehicles and renewable energy, because that is literally happening as we speak.
sentences.zh: 很多地方转向电动汽车和可再生能源并非不可能，因为这确实正在发生。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I do want to ask, though, is part of the reason why the Trump administration is so all in on fossil fuels, because as an industry, oil and gas pours money into U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想问，特朗普政府之所以如此全力押注化石燃料，部分原因是否是因为作为一个行业，石油和天然气向美国

sentences.en: elections like that is an extremely powerful lobbying group.
sentences.zh: 选举投入了大量资金，这是一个极其强大的游说团体。

sentences.en: So they have been a big supporter of President Trump, but he has also been a big supporter of the fossil fuel industry for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直是特朗普总统的大力支持者，但他长期以来也一直是化石燃料行业的大力支持者。

sentences.en: In his first term, he was a little more focused on coal.
sentences.zh: 在他的第一个任期内，他更多地关注煤炭。

sentences.en: This time around, he's a lot more focused on oil and gas.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他更多地关注石油和天然气。

sentences.en: But it's also combined with the fact that he, for a long time, has completely dismissed any concern about climate change.
sentences.zh: 但这还结合了一个事实，即他长期以来完全无视任何关于气候变化的担忧。

sentences.en: He's called a hoax.
sentences.zh: 他称之为骗局。

sentences.en: He's called a scam.
sentences.zh: 他称之为阴谋。

sentences.en: And he has also had a longstanding animosity toward wind and solar power.
sentences.zh: 而且他对风能和太阳能也一直怀有敌意。

sentences.en: An economy based on wind.
sentences.zh: 一个基于风能的经济。

sentences.en: I never understood wind, and I know windmills very much.
sentences.zh: 我从来没搞懂风能，而且我对风车非常了解。

sentences.en: And especially wind.
sentences.zh: 尤其是风能。

sentences.en: They litter our country.
sentences.zh: 它们把我们的国家弄得乱七八糟。

sentences.en: They're littered all over our country, like dropping paper, like dropping garbage.
sentences.zh: 它们在我国随处可见，就像乱扔纸屑、乱倒垃圾一样。

sentences.en: You know, he's talked about how windmills are ugly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他一直说风力发电机很丑。

sentences.en: They're not strong enough to fire up the plants that you need to make your country great.
sentences.zh: 它们产生的电力不足以驱动让国家强大的工厂。

sentences.en: He's talked about how they don't work when the wind dies down.
sentences.zh: 他曾说，当风停的时候，它们就没用了。

sentences.en: The wind doesn't blow.
sentences.zh: 风不吹的时候就没电了。

sentences.en: Those big windmills are so pathetic and so bad.
sentences.zh: 那些巨大的风力发电机既可悲又糟糕。

sentences.en: The windmills are driving the whales crazy, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，风力发电机让鲸鱼发疯了。

sentences.en: He has been saying this for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 十多年来他一直这么说。

sentences.en: I mean, today I'm playing the best course, I think, in the world, Turnberry.
sentences.zh: 我是说，今天我正在打我认为世界上最好的高尔夫球场——坦伯利球场。

sentences.en: Even though I own it, it's probably the best course in the world, right?
sentences.zh: 尽管它是我的产业，但它确实可能是世界上最好的球场，对吧？

sentences.en: Ever since he was opposing wind turbines that were going to go up in view of one of his golf courses in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 自从他反对在苏格兰的一处高尔夫球场视野范围内安装风力涡轮机以来，他就一直持这种态度。

sentences.en: And I look over the horizon and I see nine windmills, like great, at the end of the 18th.
sentences.zh: 我看向地平线，看到九台风力发电机，就像在第18洞尽头一样，真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I said, isn't that a shame?
sentences.zh: 我说，这难道不可惜吗？

sentences.en: What a shame.
sentences.zh: 真是太可惜了。

sentences.en: He has been very consistent about this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，他在这个问题上一直非常坚定。

sentences.en: Okay, so it sounds like a part of this energy policy kind of rests on the president's personal disdain.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听起来这项能源政策的一部分似乎建立在总统个人的厌恶之上。

sentences.en: But I got to ask, if we did invest as a country in windmills and solar panels and other types of renewable energies that are on the table,
sentences.zh: 但我不得不问，如果我们作为一个国家投资风力发电机、太阳能电池板以及目前讨论中的其他可再生能源，

sentences.en: wouldn't that mean more manufacturing jobs?
sentences.zh: 那难道不意味着更多的制造业就业机会吗？

sentences.en: Like, at least spiritually, that seems to be quite in line with what a lot of the administration has talked about in the second term.
sentences.zh: 从精神层面来看，这似乎与本届政府在第二任期内所谈论的内容相当一致。

sentences.en: So this was the Biden administration's big strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是拜登政府的大战略。

sentences.en: They wanted to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in clean energy technologies,
sentences.zh: 他们想要在清洁能源技术上投资数千亿美元，

sentences.en: whether it's solar farms, wind farms, factories that make solar panels, factories that make batteries and electric cars.
sentences.zh: 无论是太阳能农场、风力发电场，还是制造太阳能电池板、电池和电动汽车的工厂。

sentences.en: And it really had started to create a pretty significant domestic manufacturing boom.
sentences.zh: 这确实已经开始创造相当显著的国内制造业繁荣。

sentences.en: You had hundreds of projects around the country, you know, more than half a trillion dollars in announced investments.
sentences.zh: 全国有数百个项目，你知道，宣布的投资额超过了五千亿美元。

sentences.en: And it was really leading the way for a uptick in manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 这确实引领了制造业的增长。

sentences.en: A lot of those investments were happening in Republican-controlled states, and they were pretty popular with a number of Republican politicians.
sentences.zh: 许多投资发生在共和党控制的州，而且它们在一些共和党政客中相当受欢迎。

sentences.en: But Trump was really against it.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普确实反对它。

sentences.en: He called it the Green News scam.
sentences.zh: 他称之为“绿色新政骗局”。

sentences.en: He really wanted to undo Biden's legacy, and he pushed to repeal a lot of those policies.
sentences.zh: 他确实想推翻拜登的遗产，并推动废除许多此类政策。

sentences.en: And we are now seeing billions of dollars worth of factories getting canceled and disappearing.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到价值数十亿美元的工厂项目被取消并消失了。

sentences.en: Is it possible, though, that one part of this rationale for canceling a lot of these renewable energy projects or incentives
sentences.zh: 不过，有没有可能，取消这些可再生能源项目或激励措施的部分理由是，

sentences.en: is that there's this idea that the federal government maybe doesn't need to incentivize it anymore?
sentences.zh: 联邦政府认为可能不再需要对其进行激励了？

sentences.en: Like, these industries are well on their way?
sentences.zh: 比如，这些行业已经步入正轨了？

sentences.en: They have talked about that.
sentences.zh: 他们确实谈到过这一点。

sentences.en: At the same time, the administration has also moved to actively block wind and solar projects, particularly offshore wind projects in federal waters.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，政府也采取行动积极阻挠风能和太阳能项目，特别是联邦水域的海上风电项目。

sentences.en: And they have also tried to slow the growth of wind and solar projects on federal land.
sentences.zh: 他们还试图减缓联邦土地上风能和太阳能项目的增长。

sentences.en: So, yes, they did say, you know, at various points that wind and solar power can stand at their own,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他们确实在不同时期说过，风能和太阳能可以自力更生，

sentences.en: but they have also taken pretty significant steps to try to slow the expansion of these technologies.
sentences.zh: 但他们也采取了相当重大的措施来试图减缓这些技术的发展。

sentences.en: So, what you're saying is basically that since they're canceling projects that are already underway, it suggests that they just don't want these projects to proliferate.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，既然他们正在取消已经在进行的项目，这表明他们只是不希望这些项目扩散开来。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's also this other priority happening, which is they're really focused on winning the AI race against China.
sentences.zh: 而且还有另一个优先事项，那就是他们非常专注于赢得对华人工智能竞赛。

sentences.en: And that is a big part of their energy strategy.
sentences.zh: 这是他们能源战略的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Explain that a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 再多解释一下。

sentences.en: What does AI have to do with the energy strategy of the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 人工智能与美国的能源战略有什么关系？

sentences.en: So, the administration sees AI as the most important industry of the future.
sentences.zh: 政府将人工智能视为未来最重要的产业。

sentences.en: They are currently in a race with China and trying to dominate this industry.
sentences.zh: 他们目前正与中国展开竞争，并试图主导这一行业。

sentences.en: But that also connects to energy.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也与能源有关。

sentences.en: Right now, tech companies are trying to build hundreds of billions of dollars worth of data centers for AI, but they need enormous amounts of electricity to try to power that.
sentences.zh: 目前，科技公司正试图为人工智能建设价值数千亿美元的数据中心，但它们需要巨大的电力来维持运行。

sentences.en: Now, the administration's view is that you can really only get there with things like natural gas, with things like nuclear power that run around the clock,
sentences.zh: 现在，政府的观点是，你只能通过天然气、核能等全天候运行的能源来实现这一目标，

sentences.en: and particularly natural gas can be relatively low coSt.
sentences.zh: 尤其是天然气，其成本相对较低。

sentences.en: You know, in a lot of ways, they talk about how they don't believe that wind and solar power,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在很多方面，他们谈到自己不相信风能和太阳能，

sentences.en: which do not run all the time, can actually power these data centers and be useful for the AI race.
sentences.zh: 因为它们不能全天候运行，无法真正为这些数据中心供电，也无法对人工智能竞赛有所帮助。

sentences.en: Now, there are a lot of tech companies that disagree with that, but that is something they have said a lot.
sentences.zh: 现在，有很多科技公司不同意这一点，但这确实是他们经常说的话。

sentences.en: But couldn't, theoretically, the United States do both?
sentences.zh: 但从理论上讲，美国不能两者兼顾吗？

sentences.en: Like, couldn't we double down on the existing infrastructure in order to power our AI arms race,
sentences.zh: 比如，我们不能在加强现有基础设施以推动人工智能军备竞赛的同时，

sentences.en: but also recognize that green energy is probably a big part of the future and try to invest in that as well?
sentences.zh: 也认识到绿色能源可能是未来的重要组成部分，并尝试对其进行投资吗？

sentences.en: So there are certainly a lot of people and a lot of tech companies that think you don't actually have to choose.
sentences.zh: 当然有很多专家和科技公司认为你其实不必二选一。

sentences.en: That trying to expand the use of gas alongside the use of renewable energy would be the best strategy moving forward.
sentences.zh: 在利用可再生能源的同时扩大天然气的使用，将是未来最好的战略。

sentences.en: That if we want as much energy as possible, if we want as much electricity as possible, and we want to keep it as cheap as possible, we should really be investing in everything.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想要尽可能多的能源，尽可能多的电力，并且想尽可能降低成本，我们真的应该投资所有领域。

sentences.en: But that is really not the Trump administration's view.
sentences.zh: 但这确实不是特朗普政府的观点。

sentences.en: They are quite hostile to renewable energy, particularly wind and solar power, and just do not agree with the view that we should have an all-of-the-above energy strategy.
sentences.zh: 他们对可再生能源，特别是风能和太阳能非常敌视，根本不同意我们应该采取“全方位”能源战略的观点。

sentences.en: And, you know, Chris Wright, the energy secretary, has even said that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，能源部长克里斯·赖特甚至也这么说过。

sentences.en: The old Republican position on energy was that we should have an all-of-the-above energy policy.
sentences.zh: 共和党在能源问题上的旧立场是，我们应该采取“全方位”的能源政策。

sentences.en: We should promote all energy sources and try to get as much of it as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们应该促进所有能源，并尽可能多地获取能源。

sentences.en: And he has said, I am not for that.
sentences.zh: 而他说，我不支持这一点。

sentences.en: I am not in favor of wind and solar power.
sentences.zh: 我不支持风能和太阳能。

sentences.en: He sees them as unreliable and not worth supporting.
sentences.zh: 他认为它们不可靠，不值得支持。

sentences.en: Are we to infer then that basically the administration has decided that the threat of losing the renewables arms race is just not as big of a deal as losing the AI arms race,
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否可以推断，政府基本上认为，输掉可再生能源军备竞赛的威胁，不如输掉人工智能军备竞赛那么严重，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: That basically whatever costs we're going to pay in terms of climate change or ceding the manufacturing of solar panels to China, for instance,
sentences.zh: 基本上，为了赢得人工智能军备竞赛，我们在气候变化方面所付出的代价，或者将太阳能电池板的制造业拱手让给中国，

sentences.en: that that is worth stomaching in order to win that AI arms race.
sentences.zh: 这些都是值得忍受的。

sentences.en: It certainly seems that way.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: And you see, China has explicitly talked about how they think things like solar power, wind power, electric vehicles are the industries of the future.
sentences.zh: 而且你看，中国已经明确表示，他们认为太阳能、风能、电动汽车等是未来的产业。

sentences.en: And they have really positioned themselves to dominate in those industries.
sentences.zh: 他们确实已经将自己定位为这些行业的主导者。

sentences.en: And I've asked Trump administration officials before, are you worried about losing the race for those industries, which are very fast-growing,
sentences.zh: 我以前问过特朗普政府的官员，你们是否担心在这些快速增长的行业竞赛中落败，

sentences.en: which are, you know, at this point the world is spending something like $2 trillion a year on clean energy technologies.
sentences.zh: 要知道，目前全世界每年在清洁能源技术上的投入约为2万亿美元。

sentences.en: And they have basically said, no, we think clean energy is still a very minor part of the total global energy system.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上说，不，我们认为清洁能源在整个全球能源系统中仍然只占很小一部分。

sentences.en: And we are focused on winning this AI race, which is so much more important than anything else.
sentences.zh: 我们专注于赢得这场人工智能竞赛，这比任何其他事情都重要得多。

sentences.en: So, yes, that does seem to be their view.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这似乎确实是他们的观点。

sentences.en: We already talked a little bit about how the ground that we are ceding to China seems antithetical to the idea of bringing manufacturing back to the United States,
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论过，我们向中国让出的阵地似乎与将制造业带回美国的理念背道而驰，

sentences.en: which has been a stated policy of the current Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 而这正是现任特朗普政府既定的政策。

sentences.en: It also feels like we are ceding a lot of future ground.
sentences.zh: 这也让人感觉我们正在让出很多未来的阵地。

sentences.en: The future of AI seems like it could be a future where a lot of people who have certain jobs now do not have those jobs in the future.
sentences.zh: 人工智能的未来似乎可能是一个许多现在有工作的人在未来将失去这些工作的未来。

sentences.en: And so I wonder if we are also kind of compromising future manufacturing jobs in a way that feels a bit reminiscent of what we saw happen after NAFTA, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我怀疑我们是否也在以一种让人想起北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）之后所发生的事情的方式，损害未来的制造业就业机会，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, it feels like we have seen this movie before,
sentences.zh: 感觉就像我们以前看过这部电影一样，

sentences.en: and I wonder whether we are repeating some of the same steps that are going to lead to the same kinds of job losses that we've already seen in this country.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑我们是否正在重复同样的步骤，这将导致我们在这个国家已经看到的同样类型的失业。

sentences.en: So, I have talked to a number of people who have had that concern that, you know, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，我与许多有这种担忧的人交谈过，你知道，美国

sentences.en: invented technologies like the solar panel and the lithium-ion battery.
sentences.zh: 发明了太阳能电池板和锂离子电池等技术。

sentences.en: And we invented those things, but China got good at scaling them up, at manufacturing them, and they now dominate those industries.
sentences.zh: 我们发明了这些东西，但中国擅长扩大规模、进行制造，现在他们主导了这些行业。

sentences.en: You know, there is a real concern that with the auto industry, if we don't embrace electric vehicles, we will cede the entire global market to China
sentences.zh: 你知道，确实存在一种担忧，即在汽车行业，如果我们不拥抱电动汽车，我们将把整个全球市场让给中国，

sentences.en: because it seems like a lot of countries are headed that way.
sentences.zh: 因为看起来很多国家都在朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: So, there are real risks here to ceding some of these industries to a major competitor.
sentences.zh: 所以，将其中一些行业让给主要竞争对手确实存在真正的风险。

sentences.en: But the next president, of course, could reverse course, right, and decide that renewable energy is something that the United States needs to prioritize and invest in.
sentences.zh: 但下一任总统当然可以改变方针，对吧，并决定可再生能源是美国需要优先考虑和投资的领域。

sentences.en: But I guess the question is, by the time that happens, will the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我猜问题是，等到那时，美国

sentences.en: be so far behind China that it cannot even compete?
sentences.zh: 会不会已经落后中国太远，以至于无法竞争了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。
